Agreement number: RM1557.15 Start date: 06/08/2026 End date: 05/02/2028 Regulation: PA2023 Agreement type: Open Framework Available for: Central government, charities, education, health, local authority, blue light (police, fire, ambulance, search and rescue), devolved administrations, British overseas territories. Contents at a glance products and suppliers documents At a glance Description Benefits When you can't use this agreement How to buy Description G-Cloud 15 has replaced G-Cloud 14 . It will continue to provide a large variety of cloud based services from a range of suppliers. G-Cloud 15 is an open framework, let under the Procurement Act 2023. Services include: infrastructure as a service (IaaS) and platform as a service (PaaS) infrastructure software as a service (I-SaaS) software as a service (SaaS) cloud support services (additional services) Agreement length G-Cloud 15 will run for 4 years from 6 August 2026 (reopening after 18 months and again after 36 months). Events For future G-Cloud 15 webinars, please go to our Events page . Benefits access to over 50,000 services and over 4,000 suppliers two call-off procedures: award with competition and award without competition rapid, fully compliant routes to market transparent, upfront pricing and terms robust, tailored contracts that protect buyers pre-assessed financial stability and viability When you can't use this agreement if you require contingent labour : use RM6288 Workforce Solutions or RM6277 Non Clinical Staffing if you need co-location services : use RM6262 Crown Hosting Services if you need non-cloud related services or consultancy : use RM6190 Technology Services 4 , RM6277 Non Clinical Staffing or RM6309 Management Consultancy 4 if you need bespoke design and development : use RM1043.9 Digital Outcomes 7 if you need hardware : use RM6098 Technology Products & Associated Services 2 or RM6259 Vertical Application Solutions Recruitment is not included in G-Cloud 15. Only support relating to the cloud is permitted, not the provision of staff or interims. How to buy To get started, read the buyer guide and frequently asked questions (FAQ) document. We recommend completing pre-market engagement to help you: define your needs identify the right lot raise supplier awareness You can buy from this agreement in 2 ways: Award without competition (AWOC). Competitive selection process (two-stage and multi-stage) 1. Award without competition Use this when: your need is straightforward and low in value or complexity no additional benefit would be gained from running a competitive process your requirement can be met by an existing supplier catalogue service entry How to do it: Identify your needs and create your statement of requirements (SOR). Use the Digital Platform to apply filters to create a shortlist of services that meet your SOR. You can use filters such as: Taxonomy Social value Standardised technical type Check whether any supplier is excluded or excludable under the Procurement Act 2023 and exclude them where required. Award based on lowest price. Place your order by completing the order form. 2. Competitive selection process Use this when: your requirement is complex, high value, or needs a tailored solution you want suppliers to bid competitively to ensure best value your needs cannot be met by an existing catalogue service entry How to do it: Identify your needs and prepare a detailed SOR, including the services required and timescales. Identify the most appropriate lot for your requirement and choose your route:two-stage or multi-stage competitive selection process. Design your process, including assessment criteria, and create your tender pack. Use the Digital Platform to apply filters to create a shortlist of services that meet your statement of requirements. You can use filters such as: Taxonomy Social value Standardised technical type Check whether any supplier is excluded or excludable under the Procurement Act 2023 and exclude them where required. Issue the invitation to tender (ITT) to all eligible suppliers on your shortlist. Assess all suppliers equally and fairly against your stated criteria. Award the contract based on the most advantageous tender (MAT) and complete the order form. Agreement pricing The buyer guide includes further information about pricing for this agreement. Products and suppliers Lot 1a Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS) Use this lot to buy infrastructure as a service (IaaS) and platform as a service (PaaS). Provides platform or infrastructure services for processing and storing data, running software or networking. Cloud hosting offers the capability to deploy, manage and run software. It also provides processing, storage, or network resources. Access Lot 1a: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS).
